title: Lente CRM Frontend Analysis — Impeccable Gallery Contact Sheet Compliance
why: Comprehensive audit of current Next.js implementation against Impeccable Gallery Contact Sheet design brief (single-file HTML artifact, mobile-first, photographer's images as interface)

task.goal: Analyze Visual Design & Design System compliance against Impeccable Gallery Contact Sheet brief
task.definitionOfDone: Report with specific findings: where current implementation matches/diverges from brief's palette, typography, materials, form, and finish requirements
task.why: Visual design is the core differentiator — the brief demands 'images lead, UI follows' with zero chrome, hairlines only, pure white/charcoal palette, and specific font assignments
checks: Palette matches brief: #ffffff / #0f0f0f ground, 60% gray metadata, red/green accent rules only
Typography: Newsreader (display), JetBrains Mono (data), DM Sans (UI) — correct assignments
Materials: Masonry grid (2-col mobile, 4-col desktop), aspect ratios preserved, hairline rules only
No shadows, no cards, no chrome, no colored badges — only images and hairlines
Full-bleed images, wall-label panel (right 40% on mobile), bottom tab bar (56px)
forbiddenChanges: Do not modify any files — read-only analysis only
task.handoff: Structured findings with file:line references, severity (critical/major/minor), and specific brief clause violated

task.goal: Analyze UX / Interaction Patterns & Mobile-First Usability against brief's thumb-first mandate
task.definitionOfDone: Report on interaction model compliance: navigation, gestures, touch targets, panel behavior, tab bar, offline/empty states
task.why: Brief demands thumb-first: every primary action one-handed, bottom nav, swipe gestures, large targets. Current uses bottom sheet panel instead of right-side wall-label
checks: Bottom tab bar: 5 tabs (Today/Archive/Calendar/Insights + Settings), 56px height, FAB on mobile
Panel: current is bottom sheet (full-width slide-up), brief requires right 40% wall-label on mobile
Touch targets ≥ 48×48dp, one-handed reach zones respected
Swipe-to-dismiss on panel, pull-to-refresh on grid
Empty states clearly marked with CTA, today's shoot highlighted (amber border)
Offline banner, sync indicator, optimistic updates
forbiddenChanges: Do not modify any files — read-only analysis only
task.handoff: Structured findings with file:line references, severity, and specific brief UX clause violated

task.goal: Analyze Technical Architecture & Code Quality for production readiness
task.definitionOfDone: Report on: component architecture, state management, performance patterns, TypeScript usage, bundle concerns, PWA readiness
task.why: Single-file 1852-line component violates separation of concerns; localStorage hooks duplicated; no virtualization for grid; PWA config missing
checks: Component decomposition: page.tsx should be split into feature components
State management: 15+ useState/useReducer in single component — needs context or store
Performance: no virtualization for masonry grid, no memoization, re-renders on every state change
TypeScript: strict mode, proper interfaces, no any types
PWA: next.config.ts missing PWA plugin, manifest, service worker
Bundle: lucide-react imports 100+ icons — tree shaking check needed
Accessibility hooks: useMediaQuery, useLocalStorage — proper cleanup?
forbiddenChanges: Do not modify any files — read-only analysis only
task.handoff: Structured findings with file:line references, severity, and technical debt classification

task.goal: Analyze Accessibility, i18n, and Edge Cases against WCAG 2.1 AA and brief requirements
task.definitionOfDone: Report on: contrast, focus order, touch targets, text resize, RTL-ready, reduced motion, PT/EN parity, voice-over labels
task.why: Brief mandates: WCAG 2.1 AA, dark mode native, reduced motion, PT-BR + EN, VoiceOver/TalkBack labels, high-contrast toggle for outdoor shoots
checks: Contrast ratios: text on dark backgrounds, badge colors, focus outlines
Focus management: panel open/close, modal traps, tab order
Touch targets: all interactive ≥ 48×48dp (check badges, icons, tab bar items)
Text resize to 200%: fluid typography, no horizontal scroll
Reduced motion: @media (prefers-reduced-motion) respected in globals.css
i18n: all strings in i18n object, no hardcoded PT/EN, date-fns locales correct
ARIA: roles, labels, live regions for toasts, panel aria-modal
High-contrast mode toggle: missing per brief
RTL-ready structure: logical properties, no hardcoded left/right
forbiddenChanges: Do not modify any files — read-only analysis only
task.handoff: Structured findings with file:line references, severity, and WCAG criterion reference
